headline: Vanguard finish their schedule on top of the table
dek: Vanguard closed their conference schedule with a home win over Biola and have no match on the final day. Only Hawai'i Pacific can still draw level with them on points, and across the whole season Vanguard have won seven matches and lost seven.
displaced_by: Vanguard's season record is now level at seven wins and seven losses, so the losing-record headline no longer holds, and Westmont have a second conference defeat; Vanguard have finished their conference matches.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Kyle Denn has scored thirteen of Biola's twenty-five goals, more than half of everything his side has scored.

wire.line: Hawai'i Pacific must beat Chaminade, winless all season, to draw level on points with Vanguard at the top.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Twelve matches dated in August still carry no published result, the earliest of them Vanguard's on the season's first day.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Concordia Irvine have won nine matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Jessup have conceded forty-eight goals, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Chaminade have lost twelve matches and drawn two, scoring seven goals and conceding thirty-one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Strickler has made fifty-three saves for Westmont and conceded twenty-seven goals, a save percentage of .663.

last_match.line: Concordia Irvine have not lost since Dominican (Calif.) beat them; Westmont had not lost a conference match at home until now.

next_match.line: Hawai'i Pacific have already beaten Chaminade on their own ground this season; Chaminade are still looking for a first win.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
